profile.headline: A dependable Operations Leader dedicated to service, quality, and excellence backed by solid work history.
profile.summary:
I am an established Operations Leader with extensive experience in this field, having both MSc. and BSc. I carry forth versatile leadership skills across various industries. My areas of expertise revolve around Steering Operations and Delivering Solutions; I build and establish organizational goals by delivering great customer experience, meaningful team building, and by maintaining a comfortable business atmosphere. Through the years, I have accumulated expertise in steering multifunctional domains within the world-renown AT&T, with in-depth knowledge of managing office operations and people, while monitoring current and developing new procedures.

With a proven track record of building strong third-party vendor relationships, I carry with me, years of expertise in enabling new bridges and new customer integration and onboarding. Negotiation skills, problem-solving, following through and seeing tasks completed, and very strong time management are some skills I’ve deliberately honed through my fruitful career. I place the clients and my Team first, ensuring a great customer experience at the same time maintaining an exceptionally comfortable environment for the Team to deliver meaningful results.

I work with executive leadership to define and coordinate programs that enable staff to achieve their potential and support company objectives. I come up with innovative methods to enhance executives’ performance. I am skilled at hiring, training, and developing executives from scratch into confident and resourceful individuals. My remarkable leadership and interpersonal skills let me communicate with upper management and team members in an effective and result-oriented way. I am confident in delivering impeccable results through my dedication to handling multiple functions and activities under high-pressure environments & tight deadlines.

To know more about me or how I can assist with your business, do contact me via phone: (205) 538-5169

Areas of Expertise:
- Operations and Management 
- Executive Leadership 
- Automation 
- Analysis 
- Customer/Client Focus 
- Individual Mentoring and Team building 
- Budgeting 
- Hiring, Training and Development 
- Quality Assurance 
- Evaluations 
- Written and Presentation Skills 
- Technology Improvements 
- Business Growth and Development 
- Creative and effective problem solver 
- Strong work ethic and discipline 
- Strong Interpersonal Skills

positions.title: Senior-Business Management
positions.description:
I was primarily responsible for supporting the Presales/Solutioning community in defining and identifying potential opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness through automation. I partnered with the VP empowered representative and many others from within the business to establish best in class ideas, prioritize which innovations held the most promise, and led the effort to develop business cases in support of those ideas. I assessed and consulted on many reactive ideas for the year.
 
I provided a meaningful impact on the overall mission in the Public Sector of AT&T Business. I was part of a core team, working as a Solution Train Engineer (Project Manager), chartered with transforming the Public Sector division. I also partnered with the Process Engineers in facilitating and ultimately documenting processes. This was necessary in order for the business unit to define its future state.
 
I identified at least nine significant opportunities to improve the business and drove for more improvements through co-facilitating and/or leading three Design Thinking Solution Labs. I collaborated and innovated with my Innovation COE peers. I was a member of the daily intake triage calls, and I participated with the team to create an Initial List of Questions for Submitters.

Key achievements:
• Identified at least nine significant opportunities to improve the business and drove for more improvements through co-facilitating and leading three Design Thinking Solution Labs
• Participated in Phone/Site interviews and Job Shadowing to identify $20M in Transformation savings
• Managed the 1ST Application to “Go Live” for Public Sector EIS Application Support Team

company.name: AT&T Sales Excellence – Global Operations & Services

positions.title: Enhanced Client Services Executive Governance Team Senior Project Manager
positions.description:
Served as the integration point for key operations and governance forums to ensure visibility and alignment for some of the top opportunities.

•	Developed an Excel macro driven tool to guide Sales Executives in providing the correct demand set of data for the reviews to move very large, complex deals through the process to obtain leadership support.

positions.title: Enhanced Client Services Executive Governance Team Senior Project Manager
positions.description:
While leading this Project Management, I served as the integration point for key operations and governance forums to ensure visibility and alignment for some of the top opportunities supported by the Enhanced Client Services (ECS) organization. I reviewed and analyzed processes and tools to provide continual improvement while driving collaboration across cross-functional teams to ensure linkage with the segment/sales/ECS/Care/Product teams.

Key achievements:
• Developed an Excel macro-driven tool to guide Sales Executives in providing the correct demand set of data for the reviews to move very large, complex deals through the end-to-end deal process to quickly obtain deal leadership support and resolve critical deal issues and requests.
• Through the development and effective use of processes and review templates, reduced the number of management and executive reviews needed to approve contract terms, conditions, and pricing.

positions.title: Senior Project Manager
positions.description:
As the Pre-sales Project Manager for Network Sourcing, IBM, and large custom deals, I supported Executive Deal Leads to manage large Network Sourcing and Strategic opportunities. I managed multiple projects at the same time at different phases of the sales process. I also developed a project plan, led team meetings, maintained project documentation, obtained performance on action items, identified and managed risks, handled project communications with stakeholders, and actively managed the timeline to ensure on-time project deliverables.

Key achievements: 
• Achieved 100% On-Time Delivery of Customer deliverables.
•Project Managed Harrah’s Entertainment deal, working across internal teams to ensure product specifications are met, and contractual obligations are included, contributing to the closure of the 3-Year, $16.2M, multiple product sales.
• Project Managed the DHL USTO renewal deal, coordinating across domestic DHL and AT&T teams to gain alignment and approval for an international contract of $170M over 5 years.
• Project Managed the Smith Group renewal deal, managing contract terms, and pricing with international client teams, reaching agreement on a 6 year contract worth $90M.
